limitations.bounded_detail: No Cargo target's module tree reaches this changed Rust file: no `mod`, `#[path]` or `include!` names it, so rustc does not compile it and its change seeds no finding.

recovery.detail: No `mod`, `#[path]` or `include!` from a Cargo target reaches src/main.rs, so rustc does not compile it and its change was not analyzed. Declare it from a module its crate compiles, or delete it if it is dead code.

outcome.claim_boundary: Static analysis outcome only; no correctness, test-adequacy, runtime-execution, or merge-readiness claim.
